result:
PR [#81](https://github.com/FChecklist/claude-control/pull/81) is open against claude-control. Summary:

**Discovery:** `supervisor-entrypoint.sh` and `veridian-task.py` weren't actually tracked in git at all — they only existed live at `/opt/veridian/scripts/` (a separately-flagged drift issue). I brought both into tracking from their live content before editing, so the diff is real, not a rewrite.

**Gap 1 (stale PR branch):** `veridian-task.py`'s `cmd_checkpoint()` now reads the workspace's real current branch via `git rev-parse` and updates `task.yaml`'s existing `branch` field before handing off to the supervisor — no new field needed.

**Gap 2 (prose-only hold-for-signoff):** `tight_task_validation.py` extracts a real `HOLD_FOR_OWNER_SIGNOFF: true` marker from the prompt; `task-gateway.py` threads it into `veridian-task.py create`; `supervisor-entrypoint.sh`'s merge block now checks it first and skips auto-merge unconditionally when set.

Found and reused a sound partial attempt from an earlier failed run (verified independently against the live baseline, hashes matched). All 18 tests pass (7 new + no regressions), plus both existing shell-based supervisor tests still pass. `PROTOCOL_OWNER_AI.yaml` updated with the new article.

Flagged two real conflicts in the PR body rather than resolving them silently: PR #80 adds a competing article at the same YAML location, and the parallel DDL-preflight task will likely also touch `cmd_start()`. Did not merge — left for Owner review.
